description: Land Acquisition - Diyagala, Rathnapura D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
